title: Consolidate duplicate launcher admission-refusal fixtures
outcome: Remove condition-specific duplicate fixture refusals that exercise the same launcher admission boundary, while preserving typed refusal, null source identity and no-stage assertions.
acceptance: The launcher tests cover an unavailable owner before admission and preserve the no-stage, null source identity, and persisted refusal assertions.
Distinct dirty-submodule and before-execution and closing-source boundary tests remain, and the admission cases describe the behavior observable from the launcher.
